name: Release handoff
description: Check a declared release schema and obtain a separate human review of handoff guidance.

criteria.title: Handoff schema declaration
criteria.description: The handoff manifest must explicitly declare schema version 1.
evidenceRequirements: handoff.json with numeric schemaVersion equal to 1

criteria.title: Handoff guidance review
criteria.description: A reviewer checks whether the release handoff guidance can be followed.
evidenceRequirements: Guidance in docs/HANDOFF.md identifies the release owner and the steps to verify the release; a reviewer records a decision and rationale
